{
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "s1",
      "agent_id": "researcher",
      "description": "Research the first home battery technology (e.g., Lithium Iron Phosphate) including market adoption, cost, and efficiency.",
      "dependencies": [],
      "produces": "tech_one_research.md",

    {
      "id": "s2",
      "agent_id": "researcher",
      "description": "Research the second home battery technology (e.g., Solid-State or Flow batteries) including market adoption, cost, and efficiency.",
      "dependencies": [],
      "produces": "tech_two_research.md",
      "consumes": [],
      "rationale": "Gather market and technical data for the second technology in parallel.",
      "needs_tools": ["web_search"]
    },
    {
      "id": "s3",
      "kind": "meeting",
      "agent_id": "orchestrator",
      "attendees": ["researcher", "creative"],
      "description": "Discuss and reconcile the findings of both home battery technologies as a team.",
      "dependencies": ["s1", "s2"],
      "produces": "team_discussion_summary.md",
      "consumes": ["tech_one_research.md", "tech_two_research.md"],
      "rationale": "Bring the team together to review and discuss the research findings before writing the report.",
      "needs_tools": []
    },
    {
      "id": "s4",
      "agent_id": "creative",
      "description": "Write the final comparison report based on the research findings and team discussion.",
      "dependencies": ["s3"],
      "produces": "battery_comparison_report.md",
      "consumes": ["team_discussion_summary.md", "tech_one_research.md", "tech_two_research.md"],
      "rationale": "Format and draft the final markdown comparison report.",
      "needs_tools": []
    }
  ]
